title: Tuples Exercises
explanation: Pon a prueba tus conocimientos sobre Tuples resolviendo estos ejercicios.

exercises.question: Print the first item in the fruits tuple.
Use the correct syntax to print the number of items in the fruits tuple.
Use negative indexing to print the last item in the tuple.
Use a range of indexes to print the third, fourth, and fifth item in the tuple.
Use the correct syntax to unpack the tuple into variables.
Use the correct syntax to add a list to a tuple.
exercises.expected_output:
fruits = ('apple', 'banana', 'cherry')
fruits_list = list(fruits)
fruits_list.append('orange')
fruits = tuple(fruits_list)
